The '''15th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2004 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2003, were held at [[The Century Plaza Hotel]] in [[Los Angeles, California]] on January 17, 2004.<ref>{{cite news|title=Producers Guild goes for 'Rings'|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2004-jan-19-et-producers19-story.html|access-date=September 21, 2017|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 19, 2004|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151018125554/http://articles.latimes.com/2004/jan/19/entertainment/et-producers19|archive-date=October 18, 2015|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=2004 Wga Award Nominees; 2004 Producers Guild Award Winners|url=http://www.thefutoncritic.com/news/2004/01/20/2004-wga-award-nominees-2004-producers-guild-award-winners-16394/6378/|website=thefutoncritic.com|accessdate=September 21, 2017|date=January 20, 2004}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[John Larroquette]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Producers Guild Awards 2004 |url=http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2004.asp |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=April 10, 2020 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20081215034907/http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2004.asp |archivedate=December 15, 2008 |url-status=dead}}</ref> The nominees were announced on January 5, 2004.<ref>{{cite web|title=''Return of the King'' wins Producers, Online kudos|url=http://ew.com/article/2004/01/06/return-king-wins-producers-online-kudos/|website=EW.com|accessdate=August 27, 2017|date=January 6, 2004|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170827212325/http://ew.com/article/2004/01/06/return-king-wins-producers-online-kudos/|archivedate=August 27, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Patrick|first1=Day|title=Producers Guild posts 6 nominees|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2004-jan-06-et-quick6.2-story.html|access-date=September 21, 2017|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 6, 2004|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150910113837/http://articles.latimes.com/2004/jan/06/entertainment/et-quick6.2|archive-date=September 10, 2015|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=PGA Award Winners 1990-2010 - Producers Guild of America|url=http://www.producersguild.org/page/PGA_Award_19902010|website=www.producersguild.org|accessdate=August 27, 2017}}</ref>
